title: Frequency-sensitive video solver error
formal_object: Perturbed numerical trajectory x_{t+1}=F_t(x_t)+delta_t and terminal error e_T; derivative J_t=DF_t.
assumptions: F_t is differentiable in a specified trajectory neighborhood; local remainder is controlled.
A Fourier projector alone does not commute with spatial/temporal Jacobians.
Native motion/quality are not measured by latent terminal norm alone.

operations.input: Small local state and solver errors
operations.condition: Differentiability and bounded second derivatives locally

operations.input: Compose linearized errors to the terminal state
operations.condition: Keep order and all cross terms
operations.output: e_T approximately sum_t product_(s>t) J_s delta_t.

derivation_steps.statement: Repeated substitution yields the ordered Jacobian products on each local perturbation.
derivation_steps.justification: Products need not commute and cumulative remainder can grow outside the local regime.

derivation_steps.statement: ||sum_t P_freq J_chain delta_t||^2 includes all pairwise inner products.
derivation_steps.justification: Orthogonal Fourier bands do not make propagated errors across times independent.

derivation_steps.statement: No derived filter/controller currently optimizes amplification while preserving actual native motion under fixed solver cost.
derivation_steps.justification: Suppressing high-frequency components can remove meaningful motion; an error equation is not an algorithm.

method_expression: Incomplete: error decomposition retained; no candidate-specific update or bounded frequency controller justified.
distinguishing_prediction: A future valid intervention would need a frequency-dependent error/cost law that a budget-matched smoothing baseline does not explain.
falsifier: Reduced latent error with degraded official motion/quality or ordinary smoothing matching the effect defeats the explanation.
closest_alternative: Wan, native diffusion/flow solvers, video distillation and smoothing; current closest-work code/protocol qualification not complete.
decisive_comparison: Native video quality/motion benchmarks required. The current image tasks do not test this claim; no synthetic videos or scorer introduced.
legacy_code_audit: No fit(I08); no actual solver/motion-source construction.
review_limit: Pending complete construction and controlled remainder/native frontier; diagnostic law alone not candidate ready.
